name: Hervé Bérenger
bio: After an engineering degree in aeronautics, Hervé has been a developer for more than 25 years. He's built video games, AI frameworks, (real) flight simulators, worked for the banking industry for ten years, and then switched to mobile development in 2014. After 6 years at Applidium/Fabernovel, he joined MWM where he's currently head of the iOS development team. In his talks, he loves taking our toys apart to figure out how they work, and is always promoting a creative and playful use of technology.
